answers.reason: Full professors hold chairs and represent the highest academic rank, making them eligible for the central academic senate.
Central budget allocation is restricted to the university leadership, central administration, and deans.
Full professors are standard voting members in committees selecting candidates for vacant professorships.
Holding a chair in the faculty entitles the full professor to participate in the faculty council.
As a high-ranking office holder in the faculty who teaches, a full professor may participate in faculty-level teaching bodies.
Full professors are permitted to sit on the faculty's examination board due to their teaching and academic rank.
As a research group leader with high faculty rank, the full professor is eligible for the faculty's internal research funding round.
Higher-ranking faculty members who teach are permitted to take part in subordinate working groups revising degree modules.
Because those with higher office may take part in bodies below their level, a full professor can join teaching lab procurement.
By virtue of holding a higher office in the faculty, the full professor is permitted to take part in lower-level planning rounds.
